# `passportsim mic_set`

Set the microphone source and inject its samples.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `audio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_mic_set` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/mic_set` |
| Scenario step | `mic.set` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim mic_set <kind> [--amplitude <AMPLITUDE>] [--channels <CHANNELS>] [--duration-ms <DURATION_MS>] [--fs <FS>] [--hz <HZ>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--name <NAME>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | `--amplitude <AMPLITUDE>` | `integer` | no | - |
| `channels` | `--channels <CHANNELS>` | `integer` | no | RX slots per frame; match the guest (1 mono). |
| `duration_ms` | `--duration-ms <DURATION_MS>` | `integer` | no | Tone ms to inject. |
| `fs` | `--fs <FS>` | `integer` | no | Capture rate (16000). |
| `hz` | `--hz <HZ>` | `integer` | no | - |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `kind` | `<kind>` | `"silence"` \| `"tone"` \| `"file"` \| `"live"` | yes | - |
| `name` | `--name <NAME>` | `string` | no | - |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/mic_set.input.json`](../schema/commands/mic_set.input.json).

## Examples

### Inject 10 s of a 440 Hz tone at -6 dBFS

```sh
passportsim mic_set --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "amplitude": 16422,
  "duration_ms": 10000,
  "hz": 440,
  "kind": "tone"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "amplitude": 16422,
  "duration_ms": 10000,
  "hz": 440,
  "kind": "tone"
}
'@ | passportsim mic_set --json -
```

### Silence the microphone

```sh
passportsim mic_set --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "kind": "silence"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "kind": "silence"
}
'@ | passportsim mic_set --json -
```
